reference_scope: full text (Tier B: thresholds and key dates only); text is Bill No. 29/2024 as introduced
notes: Tier B. Reference has no thresholds (fine tiers $1,000,000 / $1,000 are penalty maxima). Both versions record the two key dates. X adds two deposit 'thresholds' (value null, depends on the amended Acts); judged unsupported as borderline. Y correctly marks thresholds not_found but adds four 'application' events that restate the offence's election-period window and the Returning Officer's writ-to-nomination window; judged unsupported as borderline (temporal scope elements rather than dated events). Both note that the text is the Bill as introduced, not the enacted Act 34 of 2024.
